clips.title: The story
paras: Borgus Steelhand seeks news of his brother Gorbold in Auberdine. The dwarven merchant asks travelers sailing west to check on Gorbold, who recently began trading in the night elven port. Their route links Stormwind Harbor with the shores of northern Kalimdor.

Borgus Steelhand trusts his family's name among traders. His brother, Gorbold Steelhand, crossed the Great Sea recently to work a merchant stall in Auberdine. Gorbold hoped to profit by supplying ships that call at Darkshore. Weeks have passed without a word, and Borgus worries about how his brother fares so far from Ironforge and Stormwind.

Travel from the Eastern Kingdoms to Kalimdor once meant a winding passage through Menethil Harbor or neutral goblin ports such as Booty Bay. Borgus directs travelers to a vessel at the southern-most dock of Stormwind Harbor. It sails directly to Auberdine's long wooden piers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Pleasure to make yer acquaintance! Name's Borgus, of the one and only Steelhand family. You can always count on a Steelhand fer a fair deal!
A few weeks back me brother Gorbold joined up with a merchant stall in Auberdine. Plenty of coin to be made supplyin' ships there, let me tell you! Lucky sod.
I haven't heard from him since--mind checking on him if yer heading that way?
There's a new ship in the harbor that will take ye straight there. Head to the southern-most dock; can't miss it!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Old Borgy sent you? Always looking out for me.
We could certainly use another set of hands around here. Business has all but stopped with the recent tragedy, and I think you could help set things right.
